mikaela: Heads-up  small webinar surge, ~12 leads showing intake:unclaimed. HubSpot webhook latency spiked ~50s and enrichment timed out. Need a narrow fallback so SDRs still get handoffs.

devon: Agree narrow only. Match utm=may_quick_demo and enrichment_status==pending -> assign to "SDR-Webinars-Short" and set suppress_task=true.

andre: Add hs_fallback=true property and short internal note: 'partial intake - enrichment pending'. That lets SDRs filter safely.

olivia: I'll monitor SF dup/task metrics for 20m. Rollback if dup_rate > 2/min or suppressed_tasks > 10 in 15m.

alerts-bot: HubSpot webhook latency spike detected: avg 52s over last 6m. Enrichment 504s at 09:14:02.

devon: Patching intake config now to add targeted fallback (staging -> smoke -> prod). Small curl applied to staging.

alerts-bot: Staging smoke passed. No dup anomalies in simulation.

devon: Rolling to prod at 09:16:18. Patch applied.

mikaela: Thanks. Keep the fallback for 30m then evaluate. I'll open a follow-up ticket for enrichment hardening.
